text: AI is changing how we create art, music, and writing. Today, computers can generate paintings, compose songs, and even write stories. Some people are amazed by these tools, while others are worried. They ask a simple question: can a machine really be creative? AI can copy styles and produce new combinations, but it does not feel emotions or have personal experiences. Human creativity comes from our feelings, memories, and imagination. Perhaps the best result is not human against machine, but humans and AI working together. AI can offer ideas and speed, while people provide meaning, emotion, and direction.
